Trace, implement and test: LCP 51. 烹饪料理

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
class Solution {
public:
    int perfectMenu(vector<int>& materials, vector<vector<int>>& cookbooks, vector<vector<int>>& attribute, int limit) {
        int n = cookbooks.size();
        int ans = -1;
        for (int mask = 0; mask < 1 << n; ++mask) {
            int a = 0, b = 0;
            vector<int> cnt(5);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                if (mask >> i & 1) {
                    int x = attribute[i][0];
                    int y = attribute[i][1];
                    a += x;
                    b += y;
                    for (int j = 0; j < cookbooks[i].size(); ++j) {
                        cnt[j] += cookbooks[i][j];
                    }
                }
                bool ok = true;
                for (int i = 0; i < 5 && ok; ++i) {
                    ok = cnt[i] <= materials[i];
                }
                if (b >= limit && ans < a && ok) {
                    ans = a;
                }
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }
};
